subject: Post-incident RCA, executive commitments & action tracker for Finosys outage
messages:
From: Alison Reed <alison@finosys.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finosys Support <support@finosys.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Major throughput degradation + errors during peak window (Jul 9)

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for jumping on the call last night. To summarize: between 16:45 and 17:10 PST on Jul 9 our production traffic saw a 3x increase in 5xx rate and tail latency spiked to 2.4s for many of our critical routes; overall throughput dropped by ~30% despite autoscaling. This caused timeouts for several customer flows and a handful of support tickets.

We need a formal RCA, a list of corrective actions with owners and dates, and an executive note we can share with our C-suite by EOD Monday. Please include any mitigations you applied during the incident and your plan to prevent recurrence.

-Alison
Director of Platform Reliability
Finosys

---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alison Reed <alison@finosys.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Major throughput degradation + errors during peak window (Jul 9)

Alison — thanks for the clear summary and for the call earlier. We own this and have a workstream underway.

Immediate notes:
- We applied a targeted routing fallback at 17:05 to route critical traffic to a warm pool (reduced 5xx to baseline within ~6 minutes).
- Short-term throttle on low-priority batch requests was enabled to preserve tail latency for interactive routes.

I’ve attached a first-pass RCA and an action-tracker CSV (finosys_rca_v1.pdf, action_tracker_INF-1824.csv). Internal owners and estimated due-dates are included for each corrective action.

I’ll sync with Tessa and Dev to confirm timelines, then share an exec-friendly summary for your C-suite. Expect our formal exec note and updated tracker by Monday 12:00 PT.

—Sean
VP, Sales (Escalations Lead)
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): finosys_rca_v1.pdf (pdf), action_tracker_INF-1824.csv (csv)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: INTERNAL: Owners + quick clarifications on action tracker

Folks — I reviewed the attached tracker and marked a few items that need owner clarification before we go to execs. Short list:

1) INF-1824: Autoscaler policy drift analysis — Owner listed as engineering-team; suggest assigning to Dev Patel and adding a 48h interim check-in.
2) KV cache TTLs: action says 'adjust TTLs' — need concrete values and a rollback plan.
3) Observability: missing traces for the 17:00–17:10 window; request from Finosys requires a trace search + retention confirmation.

Dev — can you confirm the lead on the autoscaler policy and whether a config change is required? Evelyn — can you coordinate the exec note and ensure the CFO/CTO language is succinct on risk and remediation timelines?

Tessa
Head of Customer Success Operations

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Owners + quick clarifications on action tracker

Quick update:
- I’ll own INF-1824 (autoscaler policy drift). First pass root cause: under high short-burst concurrency the scheduler deferred some leasing updates causing uneven slot packing; that combined with our prefix-KV cache misses increased per-request latency and throttled downstream compute. I’ll post a short technical write-up by EOD Sun and propose revised autoscale config + test plan.
- KV TTLs: proposing extending critical-route prefixes from 30s -> 90s for a staged 72h trial; will include metrics to watch and a rollback flag.
- Observability: we are ingesting raw traces from the Finosys traffic dump now; expect trace-level findings tomorrow morning.

Dev
Senior SWE, Serving Runtime

---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alison Reed <alison@finosys.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: FINAL: Exec summary, RCA & committed actions (Finosys outage Jul 9)

Alison — attaching an executive summary and the tracker with owners and firmed-up dates. Below is the short-form exec summary you can share with your leadership; attachment contains the technical RCA and the full action-tracker.

Executive summary (for Finosys C-suite):
- What happened: Between 16:45–17:10 PST on Jul 9 we experienced a spike in short-burst concurrent requests targeted at a small set of interactive routes. Scheduler leasing delays combined with elevated KV cache miss rates produced a compounding latency effect; autoscaler reacted but slot packing inefficiencies prevented immediate throughput recovery which caused an elevated 5xx rate and increased timeouts for customer requests.
- Immediate mitigations applied: routing fallback to warm pool (17:05), temporary throttle on batch traffic (17:07), increased priority thread allocation for interactive routes (17:10). These brought 5xx rates back to baseline within ~6 minutes.
- Root cause: interplay of scheduler leasing delays + high prefix-KV miss amplification under short-burst concurrency patterns.
- Short-term actions (owners/dates):
  • Dev Patel — INF-1824: autoscaler policy revision and test plan (deliverable: proposed config + canary by 2026-07-16).
  • Dev Patel — KV TTL staged increase for critical prefixes, monitor 72h (start 2026-07-13, rollback safepoint 2026-07-15).
  • Tessa Morgan — Observability follow-up: provide Finosys with trace export + retention confirmation by 2026-07-13.
  • Evelyn Hart — Contract & SLA review: proposed operational credit and SLA language change (proposal by 2026-07-14).

Next steps we’re tracking in action_tracker_INF-1824.csv (attached). We will hold a 15-minute sync with Finosys next Wednesday (2026-07-15) to review progress and any outstanding asks.

If you want any edits to the tone/wording before you share, let me know and we’ll revise.

Thanks,
—Sean
VP, Sales (Escalations Lead)
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): finosys_rca_v1.pdf (pdf), action_tracker_INF-1824.csv (csv)
